newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BECKHAM GOAL EARNS MANCHESTER UNITED A DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BECKHAM GOAL EARNS MANCHESTER UNITED A DRAW.

text.p: Italy's Gianfranco Zola and England's David Beckham scored a goal apiece as Chelsea drew 1-1 with Manchester United in a disappointing English premier league match on Saturday.
Zola put Chelsea ahead after just two minutes, drifting past two leaden-footed United defenders and beating Peter Schmeichel at his near post.
Beckham equalised midway through the second period, crashing home a volley off the underside of the Chelsea crossbar.
Chelsea dominated the first half while United, without suspended captain Eric Cantona, finally got into their stride after the break.
